content.text:
From the repository root, run:

```sh
just playdate-run
```

This builds Font Lab with Roboto and Source Sans 3 at 16/24 px, then opens the Playdate Simulator.

If your SDK is elsewhere:

```sh
just playdate-run --sdk "/path/to/PlaydateSDK"
```

To inspect an exported `.fnt`:

```sh
just playdate-run --font "/path/to/custom.fnt" --text "Hello world"
```

Requires the Playdate SDK, Node, and Rust/Cargo for the default fonts. The default SDK location is `~/Developer/PlaydateSDK`.

See the [Playdate README](/Users/dimitri/Documents/Code/personal/Inkplate/font_generator/tools/playdate/README.md).
I’ll build Font Lab and open it in the Playdate Simulator.
